warning.titlePre: BMW M3 CS Timing Chain Failure
paragraphs: If your M3 CS is a pre-2015 model with the N47 diesel engine - that's the early G80 generation - timing chain failure due to chain guide wear is a well-documented pattern, subject to NHTSA recall 18V-755. We replace timing chains, guides, and tensioners as standard on every N47 rebuild.
The later G80 (2015-onwards) and G80 generations use a different engine, the B47, which is significantly more reliable and doesn't share this specific issue.
warning.source: Source: NHTSA Recall 18V-755 - Timing Chain Guide Wear in N47 Engines (2012-2015)
